sources.title: 《新鍥誠意伯秘授玄徹通旨滴天髓》明末長庚館刊本二卷（NCL 06619）
sources.provider: Taiwan National Central Library — rare-book union catalog
sources.quality_notes: NCL rarecatx0306713: Ming-late Changengguan, two juan, one physical volume, Liu Ji traditional author, Kuibaosheng preface. Not proof of Liu Ji authorship. Commons NCL-06619 is digital surrogate of same copy; 1625 is modern editor's unconfirmed precision.

sources.title: 《重鐫神峯通考命理正宗》六卷，道光十年楊氏四知館刻本
sources.provider: Taiwan National Central Library — Chinese rare book union catalog
sources.quality_notes: NCL rarecatx0509886: Daoguang 10 (1830), Zhang Nan traditional author attribution, six juan. Title says recut but prior edition unbound; full target glyphs not read.

sources.title: 《神峰通考闢謬：命理正宗》，1981香港上海印書館再版
sources.provider: CiNii Books / Japan National Institute of Informatics
sources.quality_notes: Two volumes; Zhang Nan, Wei Qianli, You Daren metadata; university holdings. Cannot directly link text to 1830 Yang four-know-hall edition or prove lineage.

sources.title: 《訂正滴天髓徴義》，台北集文書局1990.9
sources.provider: CiNii Books / Japan National Institute of Informatics
sources.quality_notes: 482 pages; Liu Ji, Ren Tieqiao, Xu Lewu bibliographic responsibilities only, not proof of early original composition or literal same text with Ming print.

sources.title: 《滴天髓箋訂》凡例：長庚本、陳輯本、清鈔稿與民國注校本版次對照
sources.provider: Xinyi Books — publisher's own editorial preface
sources.quality_notes: Editorial claims 1625 Changeng imprint, 1658/1807/1824 Qing branches, Republican 1933/1935/1937/1947 editions; its Xingping Dacheng line equates 'Jiaqing ninth' with 1796, internally inconsistent (ninth year is 1804). Treat as unresolved editorial contradiction, not original folio proof.
